254:     I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a Value>,

273: fn highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
274:     search_cols: &[String],
275:     record: &Record,
276:     span: Span,
277:     config: &Config,
278:     terms: &[Value],
279:     string_style: Style,
280:     highlight_style: Style,
281: ) -> Value {
282:     let col_select = !search_cols.is_empty();
283:     let term_strs: Vec<_> = terms
284:         .iter()
285:         .map(|v| v.to_expanded_string("", config))
286:         .collect();

288:     // TODO: change API to mutate in place
289:     let mut record = record.clone();
290:     // iterator of Ok((val_str, term_str)) pairs if the value should be highlighted, otherwise Err(val)
291:     for (col, val) in record.iter_mut() {
292:         if col_select && !search_cols.contains(col) {
293:             continue;
294:         }
295:         let val_str = val.to_expanded_string("", config);
296:         let Some(term_str) = term_strs
297:             .iter()
298:             .find(|term_str| contains_ignore_case(&val_str, term_str))
299:         else {

303:         let highlighted_str =
304:             highlight_search_string(&val_str, term_str, &string_style, &highlight_style)
305:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| string_style.paint(term_str).to_string());
306: 
307:         *val = Value::string(highlighted_str, span);
308:     }
309:

311: }

313: fn contains_ignore_case(string: &str, substring: &str) -> bool {
314:     string
315:         .to_folded_case()
316:         .contains(&substring.to_folded_case())
317: }

319: fn find_with_rest_and_highlight(
320:     engine_state: &EngineState,
321:     stack: &mut Stack,
322:     call: &Call,
323:     input: PipelineData,
324: ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
325:     let head_span = call.head;
326:     let split_span = input.span().unwrap_or(head_span);
327:     let input = match input {
328:         PipelineData::Value(Value::String { ref val, .. }, _) if val.contains('\n') => Value::list(
329:             val.lines().map(|s| Value::string(s.to_string(), split_span)).collect(),
330:             split_span,
331:         )
332:         .into_pipeline_data_with_metadata(input.metadata()),
333:         _ => input,
334:     };
335:     let ctrlc = engine_state.ctrlc.clone();
336:     let engine_state = engine_state.clone();
337:     let config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
338:     let filter_config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
339:     let invert = call.has_flag(&engine_state, stack, "invert")?;
340:     let terms = call.rest::<Value>(&engine_state, stack, 0)?;
341:     let lower_terms = terms
342:         .iter()
343:         .map(|v| Value::string(v.to_expanded_string("", &config).to_lowercase(), head_span))
344:         .collect::<Vec<Value>>();
345:     let style_computer = StyleComputer::from_config(&engine_state, stack);
346:     let sample = Value::string("search result", head_span);
347:     let string_style = style_computer.compute("string", &sample);
348:     let highlight_style = style_computer.compute("search_result", &sample);
349:     let cols_to_search_in_map: Vec<String> =
350:         call.get_flag(&engine_state, stack, "columns")?.unwrap_or_default();
351:     let cols_to_search_in_filter = cols_to_search_in_map.clone();
352:     match input {
353:         PipelineData::Empty => Ok(PipelineData::Empty),
354:         PipelineData::Value(_, _) => input
355:             .map(
356:                 move |mut x| {
357:                     let span = x.span();
358:                     match &mut x {
359:                         Value::Record { val, .. } => highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
360:                             &cols_to_search_in_map, val, span, &config, &terms, string_style, highlight_style,
361:                         ),
362:                         Value::String { .. } => {
363:                             let val_str = x.to_expanded_string("", &config);
364:                             if let Some(term) = terms.iter().find(|term| {
365:                                 val_str
366:                                     .to_folded_case()
367:                                     .contains(&term.to_expanded_string("", &config).to_folded_case())
368:                             }) {
369:                                 let term_str = term.to_expanded_string("", &config);
370:                                 let highlighted_str = highlight_search_string(
371:                                     &val_str, &term_str, &string_style, &highlight_style,
372:                                 )
373:                                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| string_style.paint(&term_str).to_string());
374:                                 Value::string(highlighted_str, span)
375:                             } else {
376:                                 x
377:                             }
378:                         }
379:                         _ => x,
380:                     }
381:                 },
382:                 ctrlc.clone(),
383:             )?
384:             .filter(
385:                 move |value| {
386:                     value_should_be_printed(
387:                         value, &filter_config, &lower_terms, head_span, &cols_to_search_in_filter, invert,
388:                     )
389:                 },
390:                 ctrlc,
391:             ),
392:         PipelineData::ListStream(stream, metadata) => {
393:             let stream = stream.modify(|iter| {
394:                 iter.map(move |mut x| {
395:                     let span = x.span();
396:                     match &mut x {
397:                         Value::Record { val, .. } => highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
398:                             &cols_to_search_in_map, val, span, &config, &terms, string_style, highlight_style,
399:                         ),
400:                         _ => x,
401:                     }
402:                 })
403:                 .filter(move |value| {
404:                     value_should_be_printed(
405:                         value, &filter_config, &lower_terms, head_span, &cols_to_search_in_filter, invert,
406:                     )
407:                 })
408:             });
409:             Ok(PipelineData::ListStream(stream, metadata))
410:         }
411:         PipelineData::ByteStream(stream, ..) => {
412:             let span = stream.span();
413:             if let Some(lines) = stream.lines() {
414:                 let terms = lower_terms
415:                     .into_iter()
416:                     .map(|term| term.to_expanded_string("", &filter_config).to_lowercase())
417:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>();
418:                 let mut output: Vec<Value> = vec![];
419:                 for line in lines {
420:                     let line = line?.to_lowercase();
421:                     let matched_terms: Vec<&String> =
422:                         terms.iter().filter(|term| line.contains(term.as_str())).collect();
423:                     for term in matched_terms {
424:                         output.push(Value::string(
425:                             highlight_search_string(&line, term, &string_style, &highlight_style)?,
426:                             span,
427:                         ));
428:                     }
429:                 }
430:                 Ok(Value::list(output, span).into_pipeline_data())
431:             } else {
432:                 Ok(PipelineData::Empty)
433:             }
434:         }
435:     }
436: }

438: fn value_should_be_printed(
439:     value: &Value,
440:     filter_config: &Config,
441:     lower_terms: &[Value],
442:     span: Span,
443:     columns_to_search: &[String],
444:     invert: bool,
445: ) -> bool {
446:     let lower_value = Value::string(
447:         value.to_expanded_string("", filter_config).to_lowercase(),
448:         span,
449:     );
450: 
451:     let mut match_found = lower_terms.iter().any(|term| match value {
452:         Value::Bool { .. }
453:         | Value::Int { .. }
454:         | Value::Filesize { .. }
455:         | Value::Duration { .. }
456:         | Value::Date { .. }
457:         | Value::Range { .. }
458:         | Value::Float { .. }
459:         | Value::Closure { .. }
460:         | Value::Nothing { .. }
461:         | Value::Error { .. } => term_equals_value(term, &lower_value, span),
462:         Value::String { .. }
463:         | Value::Glob { .. }
464:         | Value::List { .. }
465:         | Value::CellPath { .. }
466:         | Value::Custom { .. } => term_contains_value(term, &lower_value, span),
467:         Value::Record { val, .. } => {
468:             record_matches_term(val, columns_to_search, filter_config, term, span)
469:         }
470:         Value::Binary { .. } => false,
471:     });
472:     if invert {
473:         match_found = !match_found;
474:     }
475:     match_found
476: }
477: 
478: fn term_contains_value(term: &Value, value: &Value, span: Span) -> bool {
479:     term.r#in(span, value, span)
480:         .map_or(false, |value| value.is_true())
481: }
482: 
483: fn term_equals_value(term: &Value, value: &Value, span: Span) -> bool {
484:     term.eq(span, value, span)
485:         .map_or(false, |value| value.is_true())
486: }
487: 
488: fn record_matches_term(
489:     record: &Record,
490:     columns_to_search: &[String],
491:     filter_config: &Config,
492:     term: &Value,
493:     span: Span,
494: ) -> bool {
495:     // Only perform column selection if given columns.
496:     let col_select = !columns_to_search.is_empty();
497:     record.iter().any(|(col, val)| {
498:         if col_select && !columns_to_search.contains(col) {
499:             return false;
500:         }
501:         let lower_val = if !val.is_error() {
502:             Value::string(
503:                 val.to_expanded_string("", filter_config).to_lowercase(),
504:                 Span::test_data(),
505:             )
506:         } else {
507:             (*val).clone()
508:         };
509:         term_contains_value(term, &lower_val, span)
510:     })
511: }
